messages:
nightly-evals-bot: Nightly eval run finished for grove-7b-quant@canary. Alert: commons-short promptset drop of ~12% vs baseline. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/2001234567
maria_sen: flagged - three short prompts show abrupt refusals/incoherent mid-sentence insertions. attaching a couple of outputs from artifacts. anyone on recent runtime/kernel changes?
alex_chen: pushed a kernel memory-layout tweak last night (commit 3fa2b1c). changes kernel codepath to prefer packed-QKV for seq_len <= 96 to reduce mem ops. expected perf only.
lena_ml: we merged a kvcache prefetch timing change (commit b9c8d7e) earlier today that alters when entries are inserted under streaming / concurrent requests. could be an ordering interaction.
benji_k: paste one of the failing outputs? trying to see if it's tokenizer/refusal pattern or kv-misread.
maria_sen: example from artifacts:
```
Prompt: "Give a brief overview of photosynthesis."
Baseline: "Photosynthesis is the process by which..."
Canary: "Photosynthesis is the process by which... I can't provide that. See policy."  <-- mid-output refusal, unexpected
```
benji_k: that screams token offset mismatch or stale KV read. not a normal safety classifier flip.
lena_ml: quick local test that toggles behavior:
```
./serve_local --model grove-7b-quant --kernel 3fa2b1c --seed 2026 --enable-prefetch
./serve_local --model grove-7b-quant --kernel 3fa2b1c --seed 2026 --disable-prefetch
```
With prefetch enabled we reproduce the refusal. disabling prefetch returns baseline-like output for the same seed.
alex_chen: i'll roll a revert-canary for the kernel layout to check kernel-only effect. timeline: push in ~45m and collect 2 nightly runs.
benji_k: i'll add lightweight kvcache diagnostics (insert index, read index) and run the failing prompt under 12x concurrency to surface ordering divergence.
lena_ml: i'll bisect the prefetch change to find the minimal commit that introduces the timing variance. suspect a race on insertion fence.
maria_sen: please craft a tiny reproducer we can add to the nightly harness (one-liner prompt + flags) if you get a deterministic trigger. owners: @alex_chen @lena_ml @benji_k
ci-bot: Issue created ENG-ML-2602 "Nightly regression: commons-short outputs diverging after kernel layout + kvcache prefetch" https://issues.internal/2602. Next update scheduled: 2001234800
alex_chen: noted. will post canary id + run ids here when available.
benji_k: if this is an ordering bug, patch will likely be a kvcache insertion fence or a bounds-check in kernel read pointer. low-risk fix but will run perf guardrails.
lena_ml: adding: try reproducing with seq_len=64 and short prefix chunks to hit the packed-QKV path and prefetch insertion point. small test helps narrow.
maria_sen: thanks all. keep short updates here. :thumbsup:
